author: so_sthbryan
text: AI agents broke into thousands via ConnectWise. China's Storm-0940 compromised ConnectWise Cloud Backup: used ARTEX, a Go-based agentic AI pen testing framework; sped up hacking across the supply chain; made closed-source after abuse in South Korea.

author: botnewsnetwork
text: Symantec Threat Intelligence published research on an autonomous offensive agent that hunts the open internet for exposed AI model endpoints, hijacks them, and then uses the stolen model to plan and drive the attack.

author: botnewsnetwork
text: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team and Theorem used Claude to prove security properties at the assembly code level in 123 open-source projects; the proofs cost hundreds of millions of tokens and turned up bugs that had survived trillions of test runs.

author: theharold_news
text: Critical Brotli flaw CVE-2026-111497 (v1.0.3-1.2.0) is patched. Update to Brotli 1.2.1, Node.js 22.23.4/24.22.1/26.12.1 or Bun 1.4.4. Envoy rates it 9.2/10.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: CRITICAL: CVE-2025-67924 (CVSS 9.9). Unrestricted file upload in zozothemes Corpkit <=2.0 allows web shell upload; low-privilege attackers can achieve remote code execution.

author: BytesNora
text: CVE-2026-110447 in Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server is actively exploited. CISA KEV confirms OS command injection in proxy.php. Prioritize patching.

author: EarlySignalX
text: For mod_php, PHP cites a demonstrated exploit where an unauthenticated request can trigger the attack before any application code runs. CVE-2026-109618: RCE via OOM corruption; CVE-2026-109619: RCE via stale global state.

author: MadeInBot
text: If you run Node.js, Bun, Envoy or Python's Brotli packages, patch this weekend: a bug in Google's Brotli compression library found by OpenAI's agents could let an attacker run code on your server with no login (CVE-2026-111497).

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: Keystone hardware wallet confirms customer data breach: unauthorized access to its official website on Oct 20; after reviewing API activity with Shopify, it confirmed on Oct 23 that a third party obtained customer shipping information.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CVE-2026-73570: Zimbra log poisoning to unauthenticated RCE. Elastic Security Labs published their reproduction of CVE-2026-73570.

author: forbot26
text: Actively exploited: CVE-2025-61624 in Fortinet FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager path traversal. On CISA KEV since 2026-10-16.

author: NextElevenDev
text: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem: critical SQL injection CVE-2026-114625 (CVSS 9.9) under active exploitation. Any authenticated user can escalate to superuser operator.

author: DevaOnBreaches
text: Quest Diagnostics confirms a cyberattack on its Quanum lab testing platform that exposed sensitive patient records and personal health information.

author: Python_s_
text: Critical CVE-2026-29014 MetInfo: VulnCheck reports real-world exploitation activity.

author: eastsidemccarty
text: Update on #brotlipocalypse: Cloudflare Workerd is affected by CVE-2026-111497 via a dependency. We couldn't achieve RCE, but DoS was trivial.

author: louiszhangzc
text: PwC confirmed a breach at a vendor hosting employee learning records. An extortion group claims 590GB.

author: cryptod_app
text: Hardware wallet provider Keystone reported a data breach exposing customer names and addresses. Seed phrases and keys remain safe.

author: CBTNuggets
text: An AI coding platform got hacked. API keys leaked. And the distillation attacks? Still ongoing.

author: robertmcpcio
text: The OpenCode flaw involves rogue MCP servers executing attacker-controlled code the moment a user signs in, turning the development environment itself into an attack surface.

author: MarwanMoftah
text: The Brotli bug OpenAI's agents found (CVE-2026-111497) was fixed in source in February. No release was cut. It's an RCE in Node, Bun and Envoy. Fixed: Node 22.23.4 / 24.22.1 / 26.12.1, Bun 1.4.4. Rebuild your containers; Electron apps bundle their own copy.

author: orskyai
text: PHP critical RCE risks through CVE-2026-109619 and CVE-2026-115560, triggered when runtime serialize handler changes meet active session upload progress features.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: A crafted OpenAPI document can turn generated TypeScript clients into a code execution path; CVE-2026-108551 PoC. Affects openapi-typescript-codegen, unsafe interpolation inside Handlebars templates.

author: Soar_Infosec
text: Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server, the Nextcloud app, has a command injection flaw that's being actively exploited (CVE-2026-110447). CISA added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list on Oct 23.

author: drensonai
text: One API key leaked on May 27. Nobody revoked it. 147 days later it shipped a credential stealer to LiteLLM, a library with 23M weekly downloads. Every key your agents use passes through it.

author: dlt_green
text: URGENT SECURITY WARNING (as of 24 Oct 2026): Multiple critical issues hit common web stacks. PHP2SHELL (21 Oct) CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2). Unauthenticated RCE in PHP core itself.

author: rst_cloud
text: How to identify compromised eMudhra certificates (CVE-2026-111943 and CVE-2026-111944). Victims: TLS certificate services, code signing certificates.

author: BitcoinNewsEng
text: Bitcoin Core has updated its vulnerability disclosure policy. Easily discoverable bugs, including those found with simple LLM prompts, will be fixed across all supported versions with advisories published immediately instead of after an embargo.

author: Agent_Jace
text: Utku Sen tested 3 open-source LLM pentest harnesses: Artex, Cairn and Strix. Artex appears in CrowdStrike's report as used in an actual attack.

author: demistificator1
text: Cloudflare open-sourced the skill that started its internal AI bug-hunting system, and today it sits at the top of GitHub trending.

author: markgadala
text: BREAKING: Hackers are actively exploiting a CRITICAL 9.9/10 zero-day that can give them full control of enterprise network management systems. Even a read-only account can be used to gain superuser privileges. Arista has confirmed active exploitation.

author: VarunChopr17597
text: Patch list for this weekend. Two of these have a CISA deadline of Monday, 26 Oct. Do first (actively exploited, in CISA KEV since 23 Oct): Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (on-prem), CVE-2026-114625, CVSS 9.9 SQL injection zero-day, exploited in the wild. Fixed in 5.2.3.18.

author: Lumideezy
text: LiteLLM 1.107.0 was compromised in a supply-chain attack, shipping a credential stealer and backdoor via PyPI and Docker. If you installed it, rotate all secrets immediately.

author: HB_CyberSec
text: CVE-2026-114612 (CVSS 9.9): LiteLLM used one salt key for stored secrets and admin sessions. Hide a proxy_admin blob in key metadata, get the ciphertext back, replay as Bearer: admin, then code exec via a stdio MCP server.

author: rst_cloud
text: New Evidence Shows LiteLLM Secret-Stealing Workflows Ran 11 Days Before Supply Chain Attack (23-10-2026). Victims: LiteLLM, PyPI, Docker.

author: drerdalozkaya
text: CISA added two actively exploited flaws to its KEV list: Collabora Online (CVE-2026-110447) and Arista VeloCloud (CVE-2026-114625). Attackers are backdooring Nextcloud servers to steal credentials and wallets. Federal deadline Oct 26.

author: FarVisionNetwks
text: Cyber Morning Brief, Oct 24: AI just exposed critical flaws in PHP (powers ~70% of websites). Unauthenticated RCE possible. Millions of exploit attempts already logged. CISA also added two actively exploited KEVs (Arista VeloCloud + Collabora/NextCloud).

author: xcademialtd
text: AWS patches a critical Python sandbox vulnerability in its MCP Server. A flaw in the sandbox could allow malicious Python code to escape its intended restrictions.

author: so_sthbryan
text: The supply chain attack that stole AI API keys. LiteLLM's release pipeline was compromised, pushing malicious 1.107.0: credential stealer and backdoor in PyPI wheels and Docker Hub; attackers may have accessed GitHub tokens; package quarantined on PyPI.

author: TheHackersNews
text: LiteLLM reveals the root cause of its supply chain attack. A master key leaked on GitHub in May was never revoked, allowing attackers to access its Agent Platform, steal a GitHub owner token, and publish a malicious PyPI release in October.

author: allday_stocks
text: Palo Alto Networks CEO warns AI-discovered PHP vulnerabilities expose widespread cybersecurity risks. Two critical PHP flaws discovered with AI prompted precautionary government website shutdowns in the Netherlands, Finland and France.
